newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore party gets 88.3 pct in GES Intl.
newsitem.headline: Singapore party gets 88.3 pct in GES Intl.

text.p: Singapore based Alxia Pte Ltd said on Wednesday it has acquired 88.34 percent of GES International Ltd (GIL) at the close of its unconditional takeover offer.

Alxia, which is the company owned by the founding members of computer-based GES Singapore, said it received valid acceptances of 9.35 million offer shares representing an additional 3.27 percent of GIL's issued and paid-up share capital.
Prior to the unconditional offer, Alxia and related parties owned 243.5 million or 85.1 percent of GIL's issued and paid-up share capital.
